note: The Dallas County results report for the May 8, 2010 joint election lists one Garland city contest, Garland District 05. It lists no Garland mayoral contest. The Dallas County 2013 entity listing shows the Garland mayor term as 2 years, ending 2015, and the City of Garland elections page names the mayor as next elected on May 1, 2027, so Garland elects its mayor in odd-numbered years.

Garland elects its mayor in odd years on a 2-year term, so a mayoral election was due in 2011. The Dallas County results report and the canvassed results database for the May 14, 2011 joint election list Garland District 06 as the only Garland contest and no mayoral contest. The Collin County 2011 report lists no Garland contest. No official document was found that shows whether the mayoral election was canceled as unopposed or why it was absent. The County site has no 2011 entity listing. The city site and archive.org searches for a 2011 order or cancellation notice returned nothing. The year stays unresolved. The Dallas County 2013 entity listing shows the Garland mayor term as 2 years, ending 2015, and the City of Garland elections page names the mayor as next elected on May 1, 2027, so Garland elects its mayor in odd-numbered years. Second pass: WebSearch was unavailable (search budget used). The archive.org CDX queries for garlandtx.gov and the Dallas County 2011 results page returned empty responses or timed out, the archive.org availability API returned no snapshot for garlandtx.gov/index.aspx?nid=256 near April 2011, WebFetch of web.archive.org is blocked, and WebFetch of the Dallas County 2011 results page returned empty content. No official document was found, so the year stays unresolved.
